name: Modified FOLFOX-6

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic FOLFOX (fluorouracil/leucovorin/oxaliplatin) backbone is not biomarker-restricted. RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested (broad multigene NGS panel also picks up POLE/POLD1, RET, NTRK) to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons, not the backbone itself: anti-EGFR (cetuximab or panitumumab) requires KRAS/NRAS/BRAF wild-type with a left-sided primary; HER2-directed therapy for HER2 amplified; checkpoint inhibitors for dMMR/MSI-H; encorafenib for BRAF V600E. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon Cancer Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B) and Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D).

lineOfTherapy: first-line, and an option in subsequent lines for metastatic disease (e.g., after prior irinotecan); not line-scoped when used as adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy

eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

drugs.name: OXALIplatin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123733): Oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 over 2 hr, day 1 only.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.route: IV, concurrently with oxaliplatin (may be given via Y-connector)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123733): LV 400 mg/m2 concurrently with oxaliplatin, day 1.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123734): 5-FU bolus 400 mg/m2, day 1, following oxaliplatin/LV.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123735): 5-FU 1,200 mg/m2/d x 2 d (2,400 mg/m2 total infusion over 46-48 hr) beginning day 1.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: moderate emetogenic risk tier (oxaliplatin) per NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template Appendix D - Antiemesis guideline prophylaxis for moderate emetic risk IV agents

G-CSF: FOLFOX-based regimens are generally low febrile-neutropenia risk; per NCCN Appendix C, low-risk regimens are not assigned a specific FN risk designation on the Template - prophylactic CSF not routinely recommended, consider per patient-specific factors

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle - platinum agent
neurologic assessment for oxaliplatin-related peripheral neuropathy

guideline.locator: Colon Cancer, Principles of Adjuvant Therapy and Chemotherapy Regimens (COL-G; Modified FOLFOX6 listed as an adjuvant regimen); Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D; FOLFOX initial and subsequent therapy); Principles of Risk Assessment for Stage II Disease (COL-F); Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B)

provenanceNote: Textbook-grounded draft. NCCN per-disease Chemotherapy Order Template appendices C, D, F, G referenced only for supportive-care sourcing; per-disease NCCN treatment guideline and hospital/institutional approval pending. Source table (DeVita Table 40.13) lists mFOLFOX-6 in the metastatic colorectal cancer setting citing Wolmark et al. 2009; mFOLFOX-6 is also widely used as adjuvant therapy in clinical practice, so both intents are listed. Earlier VERIFY-resolution (DeVita core): histology resolved to adenocarcinoma per DeVita 12th ed. Chapter 40 (line 121516, colorectal adenocarcinoma; Histologic Type section line 121080); eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function per DeVita Table 40.13 footnote (line 123747) and the metastatic-disease entry-criteria preamble (lines 123415 to 123420). ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1 guideline resolution (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon Cancer v2.2026): treatmentSetting resolved to neoadjuvant, adjuvant, and metastatic (Modified FOLFOX6 is a printed adjuvant chemotherapy regimen on COL-G; FOLFOX is initial and subsequent systemic therapy for advanced/metastatic disease on COL-D; FOLFOX is a preferred neoadjuvant option for bulky/locally advanced and for resectable synchronous metastatic disease). stage resolved to high-risk II, III, and IV (adjuvant FOLFOX is superior to fluorouracil/leucovorin for stage III and reasonable for stage II with multiple high-risk factors per COL-G and COL-F; stage IV is the advanced/metastatic setting per COL-D). lineOfTherapy resolved to first-line with a subsequent-line option in metastatic disease (COL-D initial therapy and subsequent therapy after prior irinotecan). biomarkers resolved: the cytotoxic FOLFOX backbone is not biomarker-restricted, while RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons (COL-B and COL-D).
